title: Let callers reach the agent
name: P0.9 · Let callers reach the agent

jtbd.job: Support callers need to reach the agent
jtbd.situation: If people will dial the agent, Sam gives them a number that reaches the agent, and makes sure a session ends cleanly or passes to a person when the agent should stop.
jtbd.wantsTo: Sam wants support callers to reach the agent
jtbd.soThat: so that no caller waits for a person
happySteps: In Deployment, on the inbound tab, Sam picks a number or adds one by SIP trunk.
Sam sets the call policy: max duration, max silence and four end rules.
Sam adds a transfer: an E.164 number and when to hand over.
Go live sets inbound.agent. Sam dials the number to hear the agent.

rainyTitles.title: The import fails (duplicate number 409, bad SIP host)
The number already points at another agent
The transfer number is not E.164
The number saves but callers never arrive (trunk misconfigured)
Sam wants an idle timeout on inbound
No production answer within 3 d (ST), or only Sam by day 14 (SC)
